notes.title: Disaster Blaster 1.2.0 is here – Now with Streamer Mode & Linux Support!
notes.content:
Hey disaster makers!

We’re beyond excited to drop our biggest update yet — Disaster Blaster 1.2.0 is live! This patch brings major new features, visual upgrades, and a whole new way to experience chaos with your community. Let’s break it down:

Now on Linux!
Disaster Blaster is now fully playable on Linux. The Age of the Penguin has begun. 🔫🐧 

Introducing Streamer Mode (Beta)
Ever wanted to suffer for content? Now’s your chance.

Streamer Mode is a brand-new game mode that lets you connect Disaster Blaster directly to your livestream. Your audience becomes an active part of the mayhem — spawning enemies, sabotaging your blaster, and influencing the outcome in wildly unpredictable ways.

Streamer Mode supports both Twitch and TikTok Live. Here’s how it works:

Real-time chat interaction
Viewers spawn enemies named after themselves just by chatting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/a0330b5729debf77017701e29fa48909067a11a2.jpg

The sabotage mini-game
A chaotic mini-game lets viewers try to destroy your cards during each run.

[olist]
Voting phase: Viewers vote to destroy a card by typing a number (1–6) matching its position in your blaster.
Dice roll: Before your upgrade phase, you roll a die on-screen.
Luck vs chat: If the rolled number matches the top-voted card... it's gone. Bye-bye, upgrade!
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/e20269bd52b6de04c888611d58d86f8503753dd0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/8fc8444946468701e1aa4a7f03ab1548ef414595.jpg

Turns out, people really enjoy watching you suffer. 😉

UI glow-up
We’ve revamped the look and feel of the game’s interface for a sleeker, more polished experience. It's still chaos, but it looks better now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/aa9e0f8538bc245d77ec1f66f39c16d6498b89fd.jpg

Gameplay & visual improvements

Enemies under mind control no longer take friendly fire damage.
Improved visual effects.
Minor bugs have been fixed to keep things running smoothly.


Special launch discount!
To celebrate this huge milestone, we're running an exclusive discount for a limited time. If you haven't blasted yet, now’s the perfect time to join the madness.

Thanks for all your support, feedback, and hilarious clips. We can't wait to see what chaos you'll unleash in 1.2.0!

Daniele, Caterina and Simone

notes.title: Disaster Blaster is OUT NOW! 💥
notes.content:
Ready to build your own weapon of mass destruction? 

Disaster Blaster is an innovative roguelite bullet heaven card game, where you step into the lab-coat of a questionably sane scientist, building the most over-the-top, over-engineered, and definitely unsafe weapon in the universe by assembling and optimizing a sequence of cards. Each run presents a fresh opportunity to test devastating combos against relentless alien hordes across a galaxy of increasingly unfortunate planets!

[previewyoutube=eTzyNFoRu7Y;full][/previewyoutube]


 Unique building system - add, remove, or reposition cards in your blaster’s sequence. Order matters! Different setups lead to different results.

 Absurdly fun combos - fire bullets that break the laws of physics, explode, electrify, and even mind-control enemies!

 Destroy everything - obliterate not just enemies, but the entire environment. Nothing is safe!

 Fast-paced, strategic gameplay - each run is a thrilling 10-minute session packed with choices and explosions.

 Discover new planets & alien species - encounter bizarre creatures with unique mechanics and unlock them as playable characters.

 Unlock dozens of new cards - expand your arsenal and create even wilder builds!


Join the gang of Disaster Makers and start building your ultimate weapon today! 🚀

Join the community
We'd love to hear your thoughts and see your craziest combos! Join our Discord, follow us on socials, and use #DisasterBlasterGame to share your progress!

Limited-time launch discount! 
For a limited time, enjoy 15% off Disaster Blaster's launch price! Don't miss out on this explosive deal - grab your copy now and get ready for 10 minutes of pure chaos every time! 💥

A huge thank you to all who supported us!

We want to express our deepest gratitude to everyone who believed in Disaster Blaster and to the people who supported us during this journey. This game would not be what it is today without your incredible support. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! ❤️‍🔥

Daniele, Caterina and Simone

notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo update v0.4.0 💡 New Eureka mechanic!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, actual and wannabe disaster makers! 🌍💥

We’re excited to bring you version 0.4.0 of the demo with some fresh tweaks and improvements.

[previewyoutube=kIxG8i6cU8s;full][/previewyoutube]


New Eureka mechanic 💡
We've introduced the Eureka button, a new strategic option that becomes available once you reach a certain number of points during the game. As brilliant scientists, you’ll experience a true stroke of genius, allowing you to reroll your upgrade choices once per match. Instead of the usual selection, you'll get three fresh card options, giving you a better chance to optimize your blaster upgrades. Use it wisely to push your experiments to the next level!


New soundtracks added 🎶 
This update also brings brand-new tracks to enhance the game’s atmosphere, just like the one used in the trailer above!


Minor bug fixes
We’ve tackled various minor bugs to keep your gameplay as smooth as possible.

notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo update v0.3.0 🚀
notes.content:
Hey everyone, actual and wannabe disaster makers! 🌍💥

We’re excited to bring you version 0.3.0 of the demo with some fresh tweaks and improvements.

[previewyoutube=YecYbXpXQYQ;full][/previewyoutube]


Completely redesigned HUD
We’ve completely reworked the blaster design, redesigned the card icons, and transformed everything into pixel art for a more cohesive and visually appealing experience. We hope you like it! 😄


Implemented leveling system
The leveling system increases the amount of resources you earn during matches, allowing you to unlock new planets, characters, and cards. This effect will be more impactful in the full version of the game.


Added windowed mode
You can now choose to play in windowed mode, giving you more flexibility in how you interact with the game, especially for multitasking or streamers. 


Implemented tutorial
We’ve added helpful tips that guide players through the first match, teaching them the basic strategies to succeed and enjoy the game right from the start.


Minor bug fixes
We’ve tackled various minor bugs to keep your gameplay as smooth as possible.

notes.title: Disaster Blaster Demo is out! 🚀💥
notes.content:
Disaster Blaster Demo has been released and is now available for everyone to try!

[previewyoutube=6dDz9x3xkpI;full][/previewyoutube]

Demo content

 Access to an alien character, a planet to play in, and a basic set of cards to build your blaster.
 Unlock character abilities and additional cards to explore strategic combinations.


Troubleshooting
If you’re experiencing any issues with the game, please check out our Troubleshooting thread in the Community Hub for solutions to common problems. We’ll keep it updated with fixes, so it’s a good place to start. If you still have trouble after trying the suggested solutions, don’t hesitate to report the issue in the Bug Report thread. Thanks for your support!


Bug reports
If you encounter any bugs or issues that we haven’t provided a solution for in the Troubleshooting thread while playing the demo, please report them in the Bug report thread in the Community Hub. Your feedback is incredibly valuable and helps us improve the game!

Feedback
In the main menu of the demo, you'll find a button that links to a short Google Form with just a handful of general questions about your gameplay experience. We would really appreciate it if you could take a few minutes to fill it out and share your feedback, it will help us improve the game and make it even better! Thank you for your support!

Controller support
Yep, Disaster Blaster Demo has controller support.
